decided: A sensor fires when what it measures now differs from a reference fixed before the run, and the plan did not declare that difference. A sensor that cannot read its reference says so, and that is recorded like a firing, never treated as a pass. The steward pass, a judgement, is the one exception.
alternatives: fire on an absolute level, such as any lint error or any file the plan did not list
compare against whatever the reference says when the sensor runs
why: Watching for change rather than level keeps stops rare enough to be worth it, and fixing the reference before the run means the run being watched cannot quietly move it, by editing its plan or the sensor settings, to avoid being caught.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course; when it fires, orbit writes a stop record of the tripwire kind.
What a sensor compares against, fixed before the run it watches starts, such as the planned list of files the change will touch, the size limit, or a ruling text as last agreed.
